title: Major Disruptive Events and Stays (Guest Reservations)
content:
# Major disruptive events

**Definition.** For reservations in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, a major disruptive event is a large-scale occurrence after booking — a declared natural disaster, epidemic, government travel restriction or severe infrastructure failure at the listing's location — that prevents the stay. The guest asks for it to be applied through a major-disruptive-event stay request, and Roamhaven alone decides it.

**Refund under this policy.** When such a request is approved, the guest's cancellation of that stay is refunded under this policy in place of the stay's cancellation policy: the policy's major-event refund percentage of every collected component for unspent nights (all nights when the cancellation precedes check-in), the cleaning fee in full when the cancellation precedes check-in, and the guest service fee and occupancy tax in the proportion of the refunded amounts, whatever the rate type. The refunds are posted with the major-disruptive-event reason and the reference of the request; nightly, cleaning, pet and extra-guest components are funded by the host and service fee and tax components by the platform. When the policy's setting says major-disruptive-event refunds do not count toward the service-fee refund cap, the refund never counts toward it. A denied or still-submitted request leaves the cancellation under the stay's cancellation policy.

*No longer in force:* the former clause "A major-disruptive-event refund is issued only when Roamhaven has approved the major-disruptive-event request." is no longer in force as worded; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Decision table by request status

| Status of the major-disruptive-event request | Cancellation refunded under |
|---|---|
| approved | this policy, in place of the stay's cancellation policy |
| denied | the stay's cancellation policy |
| still submitted | the stay's cancellation policy |

## What the approved refund covers

| Cancellation | Nights covered | Cleaning fee |
|---|---|---|
| precedes check-in | all nights | in full |
| after check-in | the unspent nights | not stated by this policy |

The rate type of the stay, standard or non-refundable, does not change an approved major-disruptive-event refund.

superseded_clauses: A major-disruptive-event refund is issued only when Roamhaven has approved the major-disruptive-event request.
